hero_before_mobile_crusher_revision.generation_prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: partnerships page hero photograph, landscape 4:3, at least 2400 × 1800 pixels.
Primary request: Photorealistic editorial photograph of a newly installed gold processing plant at a mine site in Tanzania. In the centre and left of the frame, a modern jaw crusher feeds a conveyor belt that runs up into a horizontal ball mill. Both sit on clean concrete foundations, with steel walkways, handrails and neatly routed pipework. The machinery is painted in muted grey with small safety-yellow details, and is clean and well maintained. Red laterite ground, a small ore stockpile beside the crusher, and dry acacia bushland and low hills in the soft-focus background. Clear mid-morning daylight from the left, soft natural shadows, true-to-life colour, slightly cool white balance. Shot from a low three-quarter angle with a 35mm lens and sharp detail on bolts, belts and steelwork. Keep the bottom-right corner calm (open ground or sky) for a text overlay. No people, no text, no logos, no brand names, no numbers on the machines, no watermark.
Mechanical constraints: Show an unambiguous continuous feed path: the crusher bottom discharge chute drops onto the low end of a supported inclined belt conveyor; the conveyor head discharges into a stationary feed chute entering the mill at its axial feed trunnion, never into the solid cylindrical shell. The ball mill cylinder is horizontal, supported at both ends on substantial trunnion bearing pedestals on concrete, with a plausible side-mounted electric motor and gearbox driving a guarded pinion and girth gear. Crusher motor and guarded belt drive sit beside the crusher. Conveyor has real idlers, return belt, head pulley drive, and supported legs. All connections physically credible; retain clear lower-right negative space.
correction_prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct only the jaw crusher outlet and its connection to the belt conveyor in this photograph. Currently a front-facing discharge chute drops crushed ore onto the ground. Replace that outlet with one continuous enclosed grey steel chute from beneath the crusher, bending rear-right and terminating directly over the conveyor's low tail loading point, so ALL crusher discharge lands on the conveyor belt and the visible ore can travel up to the existing ball mill feed chute. Remove the pile of discharged crushed rock immediately below that outlet, restore clean ground there, and retain the separate ore stockpile at the far left. Enclose the crusher motor-to-flywheel V-belt run in a plausible perforated safety-yellow guard. Preserve the ball mill, its axial feed connection, conveyor head, all other equipment, people-free Tanzanian landscape, cool natural daylight, camera angle, 4:3 framing, and open lower-right ground. No text, logos or watermarks. Output at least 2400 by 1800 pixels if supported.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Fix the single crusher-to-conveyor connection. The large enclosed grey diagonal chute currently projects FORWARD toward the viewer, ending lower than the conveyor and disconnected from it. REMOVE that entire projecting chute. Instead show a SHORT VERTICAL grey rectangular discharge chute directly UNDER THE CRUSHER, behind its right-hand side support, dropping directly onto the existing belt's LOW LEFT TAIL at the foot of the incline. The belt must extend leftwards beneath the crusher so it catches crushed material directly below the crusher body. Do not put a new outlet on the front of the crusher or anywhere below the receiving belt. The chute's lower mouth must be above, and overlapping, the receiving belt loading point; ore must visibly be received by that belt. Keep the outlet geometry simple and physically connected. Preserve the newly added yellow perforated belt-drive guard, clean ground, distant left stockpile, existing conveyor head and feed chute into the mill, horizontal ball mill and drives, blue sky, cool natural daylight, 4:3 framing and calm bottom-right foreground. No text or logos.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Rebuild the crusher discharge and the LOWER HALF of the inclined conveyor as one mechanically coherent feed assembly. The current image incorrectly has an extra short belt going down-right from the crusher, disconnected from the main belt. REMOVE THAT EXTRA SHORT BELT COMPLETELY. There must be ONE SINGLE CONTINUOUS STRAIGHT conveyor belt from beneath the crusher to the mill at upper-right. Extend the existing main inclined belt DOWN AND LEFT along the SAME STRAIGHT SLOPE until its low tail pulley sits directly under the crusher's bottom outlet, in the recessed space between the crusher foundation blocks. Raise the crusher outlet if necessary so the short vertical discharge chute has its lower lip immediately ABOVE the main belt loading point. Show crushed ore falling a short distance vertically from that chute onto this single belt; it then travels up the same continuous incline to the existing mill feed chute. There must be no other belt or front-facing chute, and no crushed ore discharged to the ground. Keep crusher, motor, perforated yellow drive guard, stockpile at far left, mill, conveyor upper-half, supports, landscape, cool daylight, camera, landscape 4:3 and open lower-right foreground unchanged. No text, logos, watermarks.
